description: NaY(C₂O₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.71 Å. Y is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.67 Å. There are four inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.40 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) C-O bond length. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.24-1.46 Å. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.22-1.44 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two C atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two C atoms.
